label: Edges (TEED)
description: Finds the edges in a photo, texture included, rather than an artist's selection of lines.
paper: X. Soria, Y. Li, M. Rouhani and A. D. Sappa, "Tiny and efficient model for the edge detection generalization", Proc. ICCV Workshops, 2023, pp. 1364-1373. https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.06468
training: TEED was trained on BIPED, a dataset by the same first author, whose README limits its use to non-commercial purposes. The weights are released under MIT by their author.
